newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Court freezes assets of troubled Hanshin.
newsitem.headline: Court freezes assets of troubled Hanshin.

text.p: A Seoul district court reviewing an application by Hanshin Construction Co for court receivership on Thursday froze assets of the debt-stricken contractor, Hanshin said on Friday.
Hanshin, ranking 24th among South Korean contractors, filed for court receivership on May 30 to seek protection from its creditors.
Hanshin has liabilities of 1.99 trillion won versus assets of 1.28 trillion won and its debt-to-equity ratio stood at 598 percent.
